alex_k: Quick heads-up — after the July deploy I'm seeing a perf regression tied to the prefix cache. Hit-rate down ~12% on 2p models, p50 generation latency +30ms. Anyone else seeing this?

nina_p: I reproduced with the sim workload. Hit-rate went from ~48% -> ~36% when we enabled the new AEAD change. Logs show a lot of 'decrypted tenant mismatch' during KV get.

omar_s: Did you check key derivation? I ran a small collision sim across 5 tenants and saw ~0.02% collisions. With encrypted cache entries we can't easily distinguish stale/mis-keyed entries, so they become misses and drive warmup.

sophie_r: If we add any per-entry tenant tag it changes the threat model. We must keep ciphertext indistinguishable across tenants. Could we include an authenticated metadata (HMAC) that's checked on read but not used for indexing?

alex_k: Example logs: 
```
$ curl -s http://metrics/prefix_cache | jq '.hit_rate'
0.361
# kvGet: key=sha256(hmac+prefix) -> value decrypt -> tenant_id mismatch -> miss
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: roll/452 applied at 2026-03-15T03:12Z — introduced aes-gcm-per-entry and centralized key handling.

nina_p: That aes-gcm change removed the tenant salt from the cache key derivation to centralize keys. Side-effect: if the HMAC key is reused across tenants the derived keyspace becomes shared — increases chance of collision and misses. We should either reintroduce tenant-specific derivation or isolate keys at lookup.

omar_s: Proposed options: 1) per-tenant AEAD keys (rotateable) 2) include tenant-id in cache key but salt with secret so raw tenant id isn't leaked in keys 3) store tenant-HMAC in side metadata store and verify on decrypt. Each has perf/ops tradeoffs.

sophie_r: Also noticed kernel selection fallout: when hit-rate drops, warmup misses lead to smaller effective batch sizes so runtime selects fallback kernel (fp16->int8 fallback path) more often, which increases per-token latency. Improving warmup reduces kernel fallback churn.

alex_k: Proposal for canary: (a) reintroduce tenant-salted key derivation + HMAC secret in the key path, (b) keep aes-gcm per-entry but write tenant-hmac to a small metadata idx (encrypted) with TTL=48h for fast verification, (c) proactive warmup: prefetch top N=50 prefixes per tenant on session start. I'll draft the PR.

nina_p: Add an audit step: run a cross-tenant collision scanner on prod traces for the last 7 days and produce a short report (hit-rate deltas, collision counts, examples). Also loop in security re: metadata leak risk.

omar_s: I'll own the sim + perf run — ETA EOD tomorrow. Will produce: baseline vs canary hit-rate, collision count, avg latency delta, kernel selection histogram.

sophie_r: I'll shepherd security review and check KMS implications for per-tenant keys + rotation. Need to update threat model doc.

alex_k: :thumbsup: Opening issue now and will push branch prefixcache/privacy-warmup. Assigning tasks to Omar/Nina/Sophie.

# Action items
- omar_s: sim + perf runs, produce CSV + graphs (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- nina_p: run collision scanner on 7d prod traces, draft audit blurb
- sophie_r: security signoff + KMS rotation notes
- alex_k: PR draft + canary plan

Small note: keep an eye on kernel selection metrics in the console (per-model kernel counts) — that gave us the signal for the fallback path.
